name: 44118 · Cleveland Hts, OH
findings: ZIP 44118 (Cleveland Hts) has 300 nonprofit organizations. 139 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 115 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44118 (Cleveland Hts) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44118 (Cleveland Hts) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
